   - The title "TERMS OF USE" is displayed at the top.
   - There are options to adjust text size (Aa) and share the document (share icon).

   - The main body contains the "Application Terms of Use" text, which outlines the legal agreement for using the application. It mentions the parties involved (NBCUniversal Media, LLC and Apple, Inc.), and advises users to read the license before downloading or using the application.
